caption: A flat piece of Styrofoam rests on a ramp of plywood, its flat base creating friction.
positive_analysis:
The foam block's flat base contacts the wooden slats, creating friction that resists sliding.
If the surface acts as a ramp, friction between the foam and wood may prevent movement.
The block remains stationary on the incline as long as the friction force is sufficient.
